strongest_wording: Under the defined Beat AML replay endpoint and query budget, querying a small number of high-scoring inhibitors and using their measured responses to update a low-rank model improved subsequent candidate selection. The incremental value of the research-procedure selector and LLM has not been established.

protocol_execution.meaning: the frozen decision rules returned CONFIRMED on the one-shot run

functional_feedback_gain.evidence: P1 +0.073 [+0.025, +0.127]; readouts from another patient lose 0.104
functional_feedback_gain.limits: archive-query replay; positive, not shown above min_useful; no net-of-cost claim

procedure_selection_gain.evidence: P2 = 0; P5 trivially non-inferior; same procedure in 5/5 folds

llm_gain.evidence: llm - maestro -0.015 [-0.050, +0.010]; its registered criterion was met only against the defective lookahead_v1

repaired_planner.evidence: corrected lookahead - exploit 0.000 [-0.061, +0.064], post hoc on exposed data; does not inherit the confirmation

total_cost_advantage.evidence: equal query counts, but bridged arms need a second assay round (about 72 h more); see units

transfer_type.meaning: every outer fold refits drug means, loadings, the expression map, thresholds, rank and procedure on Beat AML source patients; the result shows an algorithm developed on PRISM applied within Beat AML, not biological knowledge carried from PRISM

C1_virtual_cell_transfer.scientific_reading: the basal-expression prior beats nearest-sample transfer, but not the population item prior (vc0 - item -0.008 [-0.063, +0.050]); the rule does not test the strong baseline

C2_virtual_cell_beyond_pilot_matching.scientific_reading: feedback re-ranking with the model beats correlation matching on a fixed panel; it does not isolate the cell-state prior

C3_agent_adaptivity.frozen_rule: P5 non-inferiority to the best fixed procedure in hindsight
C3_agent_adaptivity.scientific_reading: a performance floor, not adaptivity: the selector picked exploit-first in every fold and matched it sample by sample (P2 = 0 exactly)

C4_agent_beats_fixed_pipelines.frozen_rule: any of P1, P2, P6 SUPPORTED
C4_agent_beats_fixed_pipelines.scientific_reading: P1 shows that exploit-first feedback beats no feedback; P2 (against the fixed exploit pipeline) is 0; P6 beats a defective comparator, which documents defect detection and rejection, not a method advantage

min_useful.frozen_rule: verdict() returns SUPPORTED when Holm p < alpha and the lower bound > 0; min_useful = 0.05 only separates NOT_SUPPORTED from INCONCLUSIVE
min_useful.consequence: SUPPORTED means any positive gain; P1's lower bound (0.025) does not show a gain above 0.05. Future protocols report the three levels separately.

per_sample.wording: about 7.3 additional replay events per 100 samples under the frozen event definition; not 7.3% of patients benefiting and not clinical benefit

units.meaning: one archived probit AUC summary for a (sample, inhibitor) pair = one drug-response query
units.physical_profile: 7-point 3-fold dilution, one well per concentration, 72 h, MTS (Tyner et al. 2018); controls (DMSO vehicle, positive-control combination) per plate
units.treatment_wells_note: 16 profiles x 7 doses = 112 treatment wells before controls and replicates; equal for every arm, so paired comparisons are unaffected
units.extra_round: about 72 h of culture plus re-plating; the replay assumes the banked sample keeps the same response state between rounds, which it cannot test
units.rna_timing: basal RNA is pre-treatment; the replay assumes it is analysed before the first selection
